ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; dominant low-intensity dark pixels (black/dark-grey) covering approximately 95% of the surface area relative to high-intensity white pixel anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark base across the entirety of the visible lobes. Distinctive high-contrast white linear streaks located medially on the right lobe. High-intensity yellowish-white clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary. Maximum amplitude serrations observed on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, resulting in an upward-pointing wing-like geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast yellowish/white pixel groups concentrated exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical high-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, with the most prominent streak located adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear white scarring on the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on the distal lobe tips.
